privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.subtitle: What Foxiem stores, and what it does not.

yourData.title: Your data
yourData.body: Foxiem currently stores this information locally:
yourData.derived: Statistics and Consistency are calculated from your history and are not stored separately.

storage.title: Where your data is stored
storage.body: Your Foxiem data is stored locally on this device. Foxiem does not currently sync this data to a remote server or cloud account.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.body: Foxiem can schedule local reminders on this device. Notification permission is requested only when you use reminders. Foxiem does not use a remote push-notification server.

cloud.title: Network and cloud
cloud.body: Foxiem product data — your profile, counting history, reminders and preferences — stays on this device and is not uploaded to a Foxiem server. No Foxiem account is required. Separately, Google Mobile Ads may communicate with Google when ads are shown.

reset.title: Reset App Data
reset.body: Reset App Data permanently removes Foxiem-owned local data from this device, including your profile, counter, history, reminders and preferences. Scheduled Foxiem reminders are also cancelled. You can do this from Profile.

privacy.policyNotConfigured: Privacy Policy link is not configured yet.

advertising.title: Advertising
advertising.body: Foxiem uses Google Mobile Ads to show banner ads on selected screens. Google and the advertising SDK may process device and ad-related information for ad delivery, measurement, fraud prevention, and — where allowed by your choices — personalization. Foxiem does not send your name, username, counter, history or reminders to AdMob as targeting data.

about.title: About
about.description: Foxiem helps you keep track of small actions, see your progress and build consistency over time.

localFirst.title: Local-first
localFirst.body: Foxiem stores your personal product data on this device. No Foxiem account is required. Banner ads may use Google Mobile Ads, which communicates with Google separately from Foxiem product storage.

reset.title: Reset app data?
reset.message:
This will permanently remove all Foxiem data stored on this device, including your profile, counts, history, reminders and preferences.

This action cannot be undone.
